residency.rule: At least 25 percent of the degree credit hours must be earned in coursework at TCC.

canonical_path.note: The residual fill closes the source-published 60-credit minimum while variable mathematics, technical, science, language, and elective choices can raise the completed award through the source-published 63-credit maximum.

other_graduation_requirements: Complete all curriculum course and credit-hour requirements.
Earn at least a 2.0 GPA in the applicable curriculum study.
Apply for graduation by the published deadline.
Resolve college obligations and receive official certification.
Use the admission catalog or a later selected catalog no more than six years old including the graduation year.

precalculus_requirement_paths.replacement: Use Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, or Foreign Language electives for the displaced preparation credits.
precalculus_requirement_paths.units: replacement credit sufficient to preserve the applicable 60-63 credit program total

modeling_notes: The current catoid 23 program, General Education, Approved Transfer Electives, and graduation pages were manually source-walked in an official browser session. The local capture currently contains only Cloudflare verification pages, so this composition must not be catalog-accepted until the intended official source roles have byte-backed captures.

The catalog's 60-63 range controls over the marketing page's 61-credit summary. A residual applicable-credit group closes the canonical 60-credit path while exact variable-credit constraints prevent analysis readiness.

Precalculus preparation is MTH 167, the MTH 161 plus MTH 162 sequence, or direct placement into MTH 263 with Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, or Foreign Language electives replacing the displaced preparation credit. The two course paths compile to identities; the placement/category path is retained explicitly in composition metadata and the canonical group's constraint because the current community-college receiver schema cannot encode a placement event.
The two humanities courses must come from two different categories among Artistic Expression, Literature and Creative Writing, and Human Culture.
The two technical selections are independent requirement nodes even where their option menus overlap. One course cannot satisfy both.

Footnote 8 is grammatically malformed. The printed CSC 215 slot and all unambiguously named alternatives are retained, while the phrase concerning additional science and PHY 201 remains an unresolved source-language constraint rather than being forced into an invented AND or OR rule.

The official catalog presents the requirements in a semester grid; this composition reorganizes those same requirements by rule and intentionally excludes semester sequencing as a prospective schedule.

requirement_groups.title: Precalculus preparation or direct-placement replacement path
requirement_groups.note: MTH 167 OR MTH 161 plus MTH 162 OR direct placement into MTH 263 with Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, or Foreign Language electives replacing the displaced preparation credit. The placement branch is retained in precalculus_requirement_paths and the exact constraint below because it has no inventable course identity.

analysis_constraints.description: A student who places directly into MTH 263 does not take a precalculus course merely to fill this slot; approved Mathematics, Natural Sciences, Social Sciences, Humanities, or Foreign Language electives replace the displaced preparation credit while the program remains 60-63 credits.

requirement_groups.title: Social science outside history
requirement_groups.note: Choose one TCC General Education Social Science course other than History.

requirement_groups.title: Humanities from two distinct categories
requirement_groups.note: Choose two courses from two different categories among Artistic Expression, Literature and Creative Writing, and Human Culture.

analysis_constraints.description: Technical slot A's footnote does not cleanly delimit whether the additional-science and PHY 201 language is one sequence or separate alternatives. No AND or OR relationship is inferred for that phrase.

Technical slot A also permits the source's additional-science and World Languages categories. The canonical receiver lists only the unambiguously named concrete courses and does not invent a representative course for either category.

sections.label: Technical slot A — printed CSC 215 slot governed by footnote 8
sections.note: Unambiguously named alternatives: PHY 201, CSC 205, CSC 215, EGR 121, EGR 122, EGR 270, CST 100, CSC 110, MTH 265, and MTH 266. The source also names additional science and World Languages categories; the relationship between additional science and PHY 201 is grammatically malformed.

analysis_constraints.description: Any World Language class is also an official option; the canonical receiver does not invent one representative language course.
The completed degree must contain at least 60 credits. A second lab science is recommended, and some receiving institutions require a science sequence.
